name: macOS Classic Theme
description: Native macOS appearance for PI-Desktop: a full design-token port of huacnlee's macOS Classic theme for Zed, in light and dark.

en.name: macOS Classic Theme
en.description: Native macOS appearance for PI-Desktop: a full design-token port of huacnlee's macOS Classic theme for Zed, in light and dark.
en.safetyNotes: Contributes CSS design tokens and two theme-switch commands only. Reads no files, opens no network, stores no data, and sends no telemetry; the only host call it makes is setting the appearance preference to one of its own themes.

zh-CN.name: macOS 经典主题
zh-CN.description: 让 PI-Desktop 呈现 macOS 原生外观：把 huacnlee 的 macOS Classic（Zed 主题）完整移植为 PI-Desktop 设计令牌，含浅色与深色两套。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只贡献 CSS 设计令牌与两个主题切换命令。不读文件、不联网、不存数据、不做遥测；唯一调用宿主的地方是把外观偏好切换成本插件自己的主题。

author: XELZSSS
